title: How does the source Workbench prove it uses the same layout it distributes?
question: How does the source Workbench prove it uses the same layout it distributes?
answer:
V3-12B: Yes. Move this repository's own affected durable support records under workbench/ with Git history preserved, "so the published source proves the same contract it generates."
BPR-7: The comprehensive ownership and routing repair is part of v3.2 and covers the full upstream LLM_Workbench source and generic templates, not only the newest Blueprint section. Downstream project Workbenches get it only through their own explicit update path; an upstream release alone does not change them.
